item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 01:25 PM 20 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesSur(Sipocot, Cabusao, Libmanan, Calabanga, Bombon, Magarao, Pamplona, Pasacao, NagaCity, Milaor, Canaman, Gainza, Camaligan, SanFernando, Tinambac, Siruma, Goa, Lagonoy, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Presentacion), #Albay(Malilipot, Bacacay, RapuRapu, SantoDomingo, CityOfTabaco), #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, PrietoDiaz and Gubat) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Ragay, Lupi), #CamarinesNorte(SanVicente, SanLorenzoRuiz, Basud, Talisay, Daet, Mercedes), #OrientalMindoro(Bongabong, Gloria, Bansud, Roxas and Mansalay) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
